title: Gun Run
description: Every kill hands you the next gun. Up to eight players drop into a sunny container yard and race up the ladder: pistol, revolver, SMG, shotgun, assault rifle, sniper, grenade launcher, rocket launcher, and finally the knife. Three kills promote you; one kill with the knife wins the match, and a stab sends the victim down a rung. Twin-stick shooting, exploding barrels, med kits and quick respawns. The boards keep your total wins and your most kills in a single match.

achievements.title: Untouchable
achievements.description: Win a match without dying once.

achievements.title: Two for One
achievements.description: Take out two opponents with one rocket or grenade.

achievements.title: Humiliation
achievements.description: Knife three opponents down a rung in one match.

achievements.title: Kaboom
achievements.description: Take out an opponent with an exploding barrel.
